input:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production ultra-wide embedded casino video-screen content for the top banner of a portrait mobile slot-game lobby
Primary request: create one original real slot-machine feature display seen perfectly front-on through glossy cabinet glass, with tactile gambling-floor depth and moving-jackpot energy; it must read as content inside a physical machine screen, not a standalone illustration or cinematic poster
Scene/backdrop: deep burgundy illuminated glass display; on the right half, a compact realistic five-reel slot window showing only image symbols such as blank gold coins, pearls, diamonds, rubies and emeralds, surrounded by a coin tray, small pearl bulbs and a restrained jackpot meter made of blank glowing capsules; on the left half, calm layered burgundy glass with subtle embossed coin arcs and soft light beams reserved for live UI text
Subject: physical reel drums behind glass, visible reel separators, believable metal rim reflections, cascading blank coins and pearls near the far right edge, tiny festive slot bulbs; no people and no mascot
Style/medium: photorealistic high-end 3D commercial casino machine screen, premium mobile slot production asset, realistic glass, metal, enamel, pearl and gemstone materials
Composition/framing: 3:2 landscape canvas designed for an ultra-wide 2.8:1 center crop; keep every important object inside the central horizontal 48 percent band; left 48 percent is quiet text-safe space; right 48 percent contains the reel window and wealth action; exact front view, no perspective tilt
Lighting/mood: warm champagne marquee glow, layered glass reflections, crisp reel highlights, celebratory gambling excitement, rich but soft
Color palette: deep warm burgundy, champagne gold, pearl ivory, tiny ruby, emerald and diamond highlights
Constraints: no title, no words, no letters, no numerals, no logos, no watermark, no currency symbols; no outer picture frame; no full cabinet; no characters; no interface buttons; center crop must remain coherent and high detail
Avoid: concept-art poster, painted casino landscape, lobby corridor, collage, split-screen seam, royal palace, empty illustration, neon cyberpunk, flat vector graphics, black-dominant scene, oversized text-like shapes
